forkChangesPreserved: Markdown links continue to expose the T3 Pretty long-press action sheet, including copy and open actions.
Markdown link presses remain delegated through the shared handler, preserving workspace-file navigation and link-type-aware routing.
Pull-request links continue to open in T3 Pretty's native pull-request view with selection haptics instead of being sent directly to an external browser.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: External markdown links that are not handled as native pull requests now use tryOpenExternalUrl with the markdown-link source instead of calling Linking.openURL directly.
The guarded external URL behavior is centralized in onMarkdownLinkPress and therefore applies to both favicon-style external links and ordinary markdown links.
